trust: November ground photos of the big-pool lawn and the steps to Enrique's. Lines are estimated from the camera pins and headings, good to about 4 m; widths and heights are read by eye. The glass fence those photos show is left out (Dave, 2026-10-11, confirmed 2026-11-12).

paths.name: Pink resin paths across the main-pool lawn
paths.note: 2026-11-12 (pool-area-errors-details): the first line ends at the inland face of the arched gateway (seafront_fence.json gate at about [-5.0, 133.4]) instead of 3 m out on the paseo, and the apron is redrawn inland of the gateway; IMG_2759 shows the path running straight into the gate across the apron.

apron.name: Flagstone apron in front of the lawn's arched gate
apron.note: Redrawn 2026-11-12 inland of the gateway: the earlier ring straddled the wall line. Extent by eye from IMG_2759 and IMG_2602.

fittings.name: Bollard lights, slatted bins and slot drains on the main-pool lawn
fittings.note: The gate-side bollard was on the paseo side of the wall line; moved inland beside the stub wall at the path edge (IMG_2759), 2026-11-12. The square grey service lid on the lawn (IMG_2761, best pin +-2.9 m) is placed about 2.5 m east of the path where that photo shows it; IMG_2760 (pin +-10.8 m) and IMG_2759 (+-18.5 m) show one or two more lids that cannot be placed from their pins, so only one is built.
